# namespace_registry_repository_policy (Resource)

Manages a repository-specific container registry image retention and expiration policy override. Exclusive repository-level ownership semantics apply with last-writer-wins behavior for each repository. Destroying this resource does not restore any previous repository policy state; instead, it eliminates the repository override by resetting expiration = nil and expiration_enforcement = EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_UNKNOWN on the server, verified by GetRepositoryPolicy returning NotFound, causing the repository to fall back to inheriting the workspace-wide default policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

# Manages repository-specific container registry image retention policy override
resource "namespace_registry_repository_policy" "frontend" {
  repository             = "my-org/frontend"
  expiration             = "168h" # 7 days
  expiration_enforcement = "EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_ENFORCE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expiration_enforcement` (String) Image expiration enforcement mode (`EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_ENFORCE` or `EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_DO_NOT_ENFORCE`).
- `repository` (String) Container repository name to apply this retention policy override to.

### Optional

- `expiration` (String) Repository-level container image expiration duration (e.g. '24h', '720h'). Must be at least 4h.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Matches the repository name.
- `revision` (Number) Monotonic revision number used for optimistic concurrency locking.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the complete repository name.
terraform import namespace_registry_repository_policy.frontend my-org/frontend
```
